Config.EnableMod.Name: Enable Mod
Config.EnableMod.Tooltip: Turn the entire mod on or off.
Config.IncludeHatedGifts.Name: Reject Hated Gifts
Config.IncludeHatedGifts.Tooltip: If enabled, items hated by an NPC will be returned to your inventory after gifting.
Config.IncludeDislikedGifts.Name: Reject Disliked Gifts
Config.IncludeDislikedGifts.Tooltip: If enabled, items disliked by an NPC will also be returned to your inventory after gifting. Leave this off to discover dislikes through trial and error.
Config.GiftLimit.Disclaimer: The friendship penalty still applies and the gift counts toward your daily and weekly limit.
